The poison cyanide binds with cytochrome oxidase, one of the carriers in the electron transport system.
Suggest how ingestion of cyanide by humans leads to death by muscle failure.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem:
Tripalmitin is a triglyceride. The chemical equation for the aerobic respiration of tripalmitin is:
$$2\text{C}_{51}\text{H}_{98}\text{O}_6 + 145\text{O}_2 \longrightarrow 102\text{CO}_2 + 98\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text:
Calculate the RQ value for tripalmitin.
Give your answer to **2 decimal places**.
Show your working.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why the usual RQ value for respiration in humans is between 0.7 and 1.0.
